title: 夫婦の心理戦をスパイドラマ風にしたら…【わが家の情報戦#1】

voice.name: Charon
voice.profile: A Japanese male narrator in his fifties with a deep, gravelly, cinematic voice, like the narrator of a dead-serious spy-thriller TV drama trailer. Natural standard Tokyo Japanese.
voice.scene: A short vertical comedy video that stages an ordinary Japanese married couple's everyday mind games as if it were a tense spy-thriller drama. Everything is played completely straight, which is what makes it funny.

narr.name: Charon
narr.profile: A Japanese male narrator in his fifties with a deep, gravelly, cinematic voice, like the narrator of a dead-serious spy-thriller TV drama trailer. Natural standard Tokyo Japanese.

wife.name: Kore
wife.profile: Reiko, a Japanese woman, 43, the sharp "investigator" of her household. A cool, low, controlled voice with precise diction; she never raises her voice; deadpan and a little scary, with dry humor. Natural standard Tokyo Japanese.

husband.name: Puck
husband.profile: Makoto, a Japanese man, 45, a timid, kind office worker who is terrible at hiding anything. A slightly high, nervous voice that cracks when he panics. Natural standard Tokyo Japanese.

inner.name: Iapetus
inner.profile: The imaginary inner self of Makoto, a timid office worker: in his head he is a cool, calm elite spy commander. A low, smooth, confident male voice, very close to the microphone. Natural standard Tokyo Japanese.

mil.name: Laomedeia
mil.profile: Chizuru, a Japanese woman, 70, the husband's cheerful, chatty mother who can never keep a secret. A bright, sing-song, gossipy older lady's voice. Natural standard Tokyo Japanese.

styles.narr: Deep, slow and deadly serious, like a spy-thriller trailer narrator. Short dramatic pauses only at the commas; keep it tight and controlled.
styles.wife: Cool, quiet and controlled, with sharp precision. A tiny dry pause before the punchline. Never shout.
styles.husband: Panicky and flustered, a bit fast, the voice slightly cracking. Comedic but natural, not cartoonish.
styles.inner: An urgent, cool whisper right at the microphone, like a calm spy commander giving orders in a crisis. Low and smooth, not breathy.
styles.mil: Cheerful, chatty and carefree, slightly sing-song; at the very end, a light "oops" tone as she realizes she has let a secret slip.
styles.soft: Quiet, soft and a little embarrassed: she tries to sound cool, but she is clearly touched. Slow, with a small smile in the voice.
styles.ask: Still deep and serious, but turning to the viewer with a hint of a smile. Unhurried.

lines.text: この家では、毎日、情報戦が行われている。
任務１。証拠は、レシート一枚。
lines.speak: 任務いち。証拠は、レシート一枚。

lines.text: 12時4分、からあげ棒。……節約してるんじゃなかった？
lines.speak: 十二時四分、からあげ棒。……節約してるんじゃなかった？

lines.text: 容疑者は、聞かれる前に自白した。
落ち着け。この3日間の失言を、すべて洗い出せ。
lines.speak: 落ち着け。この三日間の失言を、すべて洗い出せ。

lines.text: ……明日、燃えないゴミの日だから。
3か月かけて隠したへそくり。発見まで、3秒。
lines.speak: 三か月かけて隠したへそくり。発見まで、三秒。

lines.text: この辞書、あなたが開いたとこ、一度も見たことないのよ。
そして、この家で最も危険な人物。
誠ちゃんね、あなたの誕生日にネックレス予約してたのよ〜。あら、これ内緒だった？
lines.speak: まことちゃんね、あなたの誕生日にネックレス予約してたのよ〜。あら、これ内緒だった？
lines.sub: 誠ちゃんね、あなたの誕生日に|ネックレス予約してたのよ〜。|あら、これ内緒だった？

lines.text: あなたの家の情報屋は、誰ですか？
